items.title: Michael Wilson: Four catches in first game after MHJ trade
items.text:
Wilson caught four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

items.title: Josh Downs: Four grabs in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Downs caught four of eight targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. He added seven rushing yards on his only carry.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Picked off twice in rough Week 6 loss
items.text:
Jones completed 22 of 42 passes for 269 yards and a touchdown with two interceptions in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Strong showing in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Taylor carried the ball 21 times for 94 yards and a touchdown and caught two of four targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. He also lost a fumble.
